title: Violence, Memory and Transitional Justice
description: Examines human rights, remembering and accountability in the aftermath of conflict and authoritarian rule. Focuses on a wide range of sources (such as truth commissions, memorials, testimonies and artistic representations) across a range of national experiences, laying bare the human costs of state violence and a multitude of cultural and legal efforts to establish historical memory.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of HSTR 373A, HSTR 371 (if taken in the same topic).
